title: Standup collage: control plane, routing, auth & quotas (Jan 13 2027)
content:
Purpose: quick combined capture of standup micro-updates across control plane, routing, auth, and quotas. This is intentionally informal — pasted fragments from three standups + a short incident sketch and action list.

Attendees (rotating): Aisha, Marco, Lena, Ravi, Samir, Jo (observability), Priya (SRE oncall check-in)

1) Morning runthrough (control plane)
- Quick status: canary of controlplane v0.21 rolled to 2 nodes in us-west-2; prober latency looks fine for ~95% traffic. Observed 130ms p95 (baseline ~120ms).
- Oddity: KV store compaction task on node-2 spiked CPU for ~15m at 03:12 UTC; leader election churned once. No API timeouts reported beyond a handful of 5xx.
- Hypothesis: compaction task scheduled concurrently with backup window — overlap caused IO saturation.
- Temporary mitigation: shifted compaction window to 05:30 UTC today, set compaction parallelism=1 on affected shard.
- Follow-up: storage team to propose safer default compaction backoff (Ravi). Ticket: JIRA-PLT-1427.

2) Routing & quotas snippet
- Quota anomaly observed 2027-01-12 22:40 UTC: several customers hit unexpected per-tenant qps cap even though usage looked within reservation. Root cause: rate limiter config reload failed to apply the new dynamic-key mapping; the legacy default bucket remained active.
- Immediate action: Flipped the feature flag to fallback mapping for 2 hours; this restored expected behavior.
- Longer term: Implement a dry-run mode for quota-config reloads and add a metric for reload success boolean (tracked by Marco).
- Note: this explains a support ticket where a customer reported throttling right at high-burst times — CS ticket SR-9482 linked.

3) Auth & tokens quick notes
- Spike of token validation errors (invalid-signature) peaked ~01:05 UTC; correlated with a failed key-rotation job from the KMS pipeline.
- KMS rotation retried and recovered automatically but ~18k requests received the transient 401 before fallback kicked in.
- Mitigation: enable longer overlap window for key rotation + add a retry path in token validation to consult secondary JWKS endpoint (Lena to action). PR: github.com/redwood-inference/auth/pull/441 (draft).
- Implementation impact: a short-term increase in token-validation latency for retried requests; SLO still intact but alert noise needs pruning.

4) Observability & tracing
- Jo: added a temporary trace tag 'rotation_attempt' to distinguish auth rotations in logs. Helped map the 401 burst to a single rotation run.
- Suggested new dashboard: 'config-reload-health' — shows last successful reload timestamp per subsystem, last error, and delta to alert on >2min stale. (Proposal in Confluence: platform-routing-runbook).

5) Mini postmortem sketch (for the quota reload incident)
- What happened: dynamic quota mapping reload failed due to a panic in the parser when encountering an unexpected enum value in a proto wire blob. Parser returned error, reload aborted, and legacy default persisted.
- Why it matters: customers on dynamic tiers received fallback bucket and saw throttling that looked like over-throttling.
- Immediate fix: add defensive parsing and a test for unknown-enum handling.
- Permanent fix: feature gating for dynamic reloads + dry-run & activation step + rollout plan. (Marco + Samir to own).

6) Blockers & asks to other teams
- Storage: confirm compaction schedule changes don't affect new regions. (Ravi)
- SRE: threshold for alert suppression during planned rolling deploys — want to avoid noisy alerts when compaction/backups overlap. (Priya)
- CS: notify affected customers for quota incident with brief timeline — draft suggested by Aisha.
- Security: quick sign-off on secondary JWKS read path (Lena).

7) Action items (who / ETA)
- Ravi: create compaction backoff proposal + rollback plan — ETA 2027-01-18.
- Marco: implement reload-success metric + dashboard stub — ETA 2027-01-15.
- Lena: open PR for secondary JWKS fallback + unit tests — ETA 2027-01-19.
- Samir: write the DRY-RUN plan for quota-config reload and add to runbook — ETA 2027-01-20.
- Aisha: draft customer-facing note for quota incident, coordinate with CS — ETA 2027-01-14.

8) Misc standing items (brief)
- Canary checklist update: add a step to validate cross-service config reloads before traffic ramp.
- Weekly experiments: routing fallback policy test (A/B): if v2 route fails, route 15% traffic to cold-model fallback — starting next Tuesday.
- Notes to self: collect sample traces from the 01:05 token error window and attach to JIRA-PLT-1427.

9) Quick retrospective (2-min)
- What went well: fast detection because of recently added trace tags; rollback & fallback reduced customer impact.
- Improvements: more defensive parsing, dry-run for reloads, and clearer observability for config operations.

10) Raw meeting fragments (copied from chat / voice notes)
- "KV compaction overlapped backup — saw CPU spike on node-2, we moved window. follow-up: tune compaction parallelism" — Ravi
- "Feature flag fallback saved the day for quotas; need to make reload less brittle" — Marco
- "Add secondary JWKS read path asap; also please sequence key rotation windows so overlap is safe" — Lena
- "Canary checklist should include config-reload smoke test" — Jo

End notes: put the next combined standup capture on Jan 20; keep this doc as a scratchpad until follow-ups are resolved.

-- Aisha (standup lead)
